source: Common US employer benefits as the builder knows them; verify the figures with each employer's own summary

counts.match: the match row computes it from the W-2 deferral
counts.worth: counted as benefits worth and in total compensation, never as cash
counts.cash: counted as cash income under Benefits

kinds.label: 401(k) match
kinds.add: The plan summary or HR: the match formula, usually "50% of the first 6%".
kinds.details: The rate, the cap as a share of pay, and the vesting schedule.
kinds.quantify: Rate times cap times gross pay, counted only on what you defer; the match row computes it from the W-2 deferral.

kinds.label: HSA deposit from the employer
kinds.add: The benefits summary or the HSA statement: the yearly employer deposit.
kinds.details: The yearly amount, and whether it is single or family coverage.
kinds.quantify: The yearly deposit over twelve; it is money in your account, not pay.

kinds.label: Health insurance premium the employer pays
kinds.add: The open enrollment summary or a pay stub: the employer share per paycheck.
kinds.details: The plan, who is covered, and the employer share.
kinds.quantify: The employer share times paychecks a year over twelve: what the same cover would cost you.

kinds.label: Dental and vision the employer pays
kinds.add: The open enrollment summary: the employer share.

kinds.label: Life insurance the employer pays
kinds.add: The benefits summary: the cover amount and any premium you pay.
kinds.details: The cover as a multiple of salary; whether it goes with the job.
kinds.quantify: What the same term cover would cost you a month; small for most, not nothing.

kinds.label: Disability insurance the employer pays
kinds.add: The benefits summary: short and long term, and the share of pay replaced.
kinds.details: Share of pay replaced, waiting period, whether the premium is pre-tax.
kinds.quantify: What the same cover would cost you a month.

kinds.label: Commuter or parking
kinds.add: The benefits portal: the monthly allowance or the pre-tax election.
kinds.details: The monthly amount and whether it is a subsidy or your own pre-tax money.
kinds.quantify: The subsidy a month; a pre-tax election is your money and counts as spending instead.

kinds.label: Phone or internet stipend
kinds.add: The expense policy or a pay stub line.
kinds.quantify: The stipend a month, as cash income.

kinds.label: Tuition or learning budget
kinds.add: The learning policy: the yearly cap and what counts.
kinds.details: The yearly cap, what qualifies, whether it must be repaid on leaving.
kinds.quantify: What you will actually use a year, over twelve.

kinds.label: Student loan payment help
kinds.add: The benefits summary: the monthly payment the employer makes.
kinds.details: The monthly amount and the lifetime cap.
kinds.quantify: The payment a month, as cash toward the loan.

kinds.label: Stock purchase discount
kinds.add: The plan document: the discount and the purchase period.
kinds.details: The discount, the look-back, the yearly limit, whether you sell at once.
kinds.quantify: The discount times what you buy a year, over twelve.

kinds.label: Pension or employer retirement credit
kinds.add: The plan statement: the yearly employer credit or the formula.
kinds.details: The credit, vesting, whether it is a cash balance or a formula.
kinds.quantify: The yearly employer credit over twelve.

kinds.label: Something else
kinds.details: What it is and what it is worth.
kinds.quantify: A dollar figure a month or a year.
